neighbours.label: 'upon' completing a verb + preposition phrase (improve upon, build upon, rely upon); the same verbs with 'on' stay quiet
fire: The second edition builds upon the ideas of the first.
Farmers in the valley rely upon the spring floods.
Each generation tries to improve upon the work of the last.
The new law draws upon decades of research.
We must not look upon failure as the end.
The ruling was based upon a narrow reading of the law.
She stumbled upon an old diary in the attic.
The treaty was agreed upon after months of talks.
